pages.text: How Many? Author: Sudeshna Shome Ghosh Illustrator: Sayan Mukherjee
1 snail tells them a joke. How many snails can you see?
2 fish in the pool, 3 more fish make it a school. How many fish?
3 pigs playing in the sun, 4 pigs join the fun! How many pigs can you see?
4 butterflies flit and fly, 5 butterflies wave bye-bye. How many butterflies can you see?
5 worms slip and slide, How many worms can you see? 5 more worms join the ride.
10 ants all in a row, Look, here come 2 more. How many ants can you see?
How many creatures can you count? Snail + Fish + Butterfly + Pig + Ant + Worm
